name: the flips are applied in the image's own frame
why: Before the rotation in the transform list, a flip is on screen: H mirrors left-right as SEEN. Moved after the rotation it mirrors the image's own axis, which on a turned image is top-bottom.
grep: on a turned image H still mirrors

name: R ignores the mirror
why: A mirror reverses a turn's direction; without the correction R turns anticlockwise as seen on a mirrored image.
grep: on a turned image H still mirrors

name: a step keeps the flips
why: H mirrors one see-through scan; the next image starts unflipped, as it starts upright.
grep: H and V mirror in place

name: the translate is applied inside the flips
why: The translate stays outermost so the pan is on screen; inside a vertical flip a pointer near the bottom pans to the top.

name: the Flip button does not show the state
why: A flip does not re-render, so the button's aria-pressed is set in place.
grep: H and V mirror in place

name: no V key
grep: H and V mirror in place
